changeSet.author: cogoal
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT ck_users_email_lower CHECK (email = lower(email))

INSERT INTO users(legacy_id,username,email,password_hash,name,role,created_at,updated_at,avatar_url,profile_version,failed_login_attempts,locked_until) SELECT u.id,u.username,u.email,u.password_hash,u.name, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legacy_user_role r WHERE r.user_id=u.id AND r.role='ADMIN') THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'USER' END, u.created_at,u.updated_at,u.avatar_url,u.profile_version,u.failed_login_attempts,u.locked_until FROM legacy_users u ORDER BY u.created_at,u.id; INSERT INTO auth_tokens(user_id,token_hash,type,expires_at,revoked_at,created_at,family_id) SELECT u.id,t.token_hash,'REFRESH',t.expires_at,t.revoked_at,t.created_at,t.family_id FROM legacy_refresh_token t JOIN users u ON u.legacy_id=t.user_id; INSERT INTO auth_tokens(user_id,token_hash,type,new_email,expires_at,used_at) SELECT u.id,t.token_hash,CASE WHEN t.purpose='EMAIL_CHANGE' THEN 'EMAIL_CONFIRM' ELSE t.purpose END, CASE WHEN t.purpose='EMAIL_CHANGE' THEN t.email ELSE NULL END,t.expires_at, CASE WHEN t.consumed THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END FROM legacy_account_action_token t JOIN users u ON u.legacy_id=t.user_id;
